title: Elite: Statues of Jealous Victory: Hidden Law
description: Statues of Jealous Victory unfolds across mirror-victory hall with living statue lanes and polished judgment floors, pushing a one active Titan Olympian Titan to prove elite balanced pressure, precision, dueling, morale momentum. without violating established Realm canon. Appearance rule: Celestial Heights of Olympus is the source culture humans later copied as Greek divine court myth; mission terrain and cosmetics must show living marble-light, bronze cuirasses, laurel circuits, aegis scales, oracle smoke, thunder tribunal halos, gold-blue skyfire.
lore: This mission treats Celestial Heights of Olympus as the origin behind Greek divine court myth: battlefield architecture, reward cosmetics, relic props, and hazard silhouettes must use living marble-light, bronze cuirasses, laurel circuits, aegis scales, oracle smoke, thunder tribunal halos, gold-blue skyfire instead of generic historical or RPG dressing.
terrain: mirror-victory hall with living statue lanes and polished judgment floors; source-culture appearance layer: laurel trial arenas, marble sky platforms, oracle smoke lanes, aegis tribunal shields, thunder verdict courts; cosmetic/relic silhouettes: aegis laurel spears, living marble bronze cuirasses, oracle ambrosia cores, Athena countermeasure silhouettes
